allow_instructions: Allow read-only repository inspection such as git status, git diff, git log, git show, git branch --show-current, git rev-parse, find, grep, rg, cat, sed, and ls.

Allow running repository-local unit tests, contract tests, integration tests, lint checks, type checks, formatting checks, frontend builds, and Playwright tests when they do not modify production infrastructure.
Allow uv commands that use the existing lockfile without changing dependency versions, including uv sync --frozen, uv run pytest, uv run ruff, uv run mypy, and uv run ty.
Allow Bun commands that use the existing lockfile and repository scripts, including bun install --frozen-lockfile, bun run build, bun run lint, and bun run test.
Allow read-only Docker inspection commands such as docker ps, docker info, docker compose ps, docker compose logs, and docker compose config.
Allow starting or restarting this repository's local development and test services with docker compose when required for Redis, PostgreSQL, LiteLLM, backend, frontend, or E2E verification.
Allow localhost health checks and test requests required to verify this repository's local services.
Allow creating and editing files inside the current workspace when the edit is within the explicitly approved stage and scope.
block_instructions: Require explicit approval before any git push, force push, rebase, branch deletion, git reset --hard, git clean, or any command that may discard uncommitted user changes.
Require explicit approval before deleting files or directories, except disposable build artifacts that are explicitly part of the current approved task.
Require explicit approval before docker system prune, docker volume rm, docker image rm, docker container rm, docker compose down -v, or other destructive Docker cleanup.
Require explicit approval before dropping, truncating, resetting, or destructively migrating any database or Redis data.
Require explicit approval before modifying production infrastructure, production databases, production Redis, cloud resources, DNS, CI secrets, deployment credentials, or remote environments.
Require explicit approval before reading or modifying secrets, .env files containing real credentials, SSH configuration, shell credential stores, API keys, tokens, certificates, or private keys.

Require explicit approval before adding, removing, or upgrading dependencies, changing version pins, changing lockfiles for dependency upgrades, patching site-packages, or vendoring third-party libraries.

Require explicit approval before modifying AGENTS.md, .cursor/permissions.json, .cursor/sandbox.json, .cursor rules, or other agent-governance files unless the current task explicitly requests that change.

Require explicit approval before changing architecture ownership, persistence boundaries, public API contracts, timeout/retry/fallback policy, security boundaries, or current milestone status unless explicitly included in the approved stage.
Do not weaken tests, delete failing tests, skip tests, relax type checking, disable authentication or authorization, or remove runtime safety limits merely to make validation pass.
